title: Transaction evidence — every state, its screenshot, its proof
kicker: representation lab · gastify transaction · real captures
card: One entity's evidence navigator — workflow dropdown, an indented bracket tree per workflow (sections derive their children; depth = dependency, siblings = parallel paths), the selected step's production capture + provenance right, ✎ write-marks and running/unpowered/ghost evidence states.
lede: Every step a gastify transaction workflow can reach, and what proves it: pick a workflow, click any node on the tree, and its production screenshot opens with the spec, code, models and cases behind it.
handle: The diagram is the index; the screenshot is the evidence.
source: proof manifests tx2b-journey · tx1-detail-reskin · txflows-journey; backend/app/api/transactions.py + models as read 2026-08-04; counts recountable from those files.
